findings.NotACrop: Antigravity's 256 px icon from its exe has alpha 0 outside 21-235, so no shadow, and its corners sit inside the artwork bounds.
findings.Cause: The tray source is 512 px shown at 24-29 px; composition's bilinear sampling steps over about 17 source pixels. A simulation of no low-pass at 24 and 29 px gives the stairs the user described, and averaging gives rounded corners. The 0.8.107 pixels were not captured; the 0.8.108 pixels were, and are smooth.
findings.WrongClaim: The 0.8.107 report and docs said a large source could not look bad. That was wrong.
